title: 第15章 升级2级房屋第16章 雾影石1级菜地
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
“今天晚上不能睡了！”
沈易脑海里只剩下一个念头。
他没有选择立即升级房屋。
今夜需要时时刻刻盯着，若是有更多的雾影怪加入进来的话，会对房子的耐久值造成更大的损耗。
现有的耐久值能撑一会是一会，尽量争取多一刻周转的时机。
沈坤神情紧张，低声道：“大哥，怎么会有这么多雾影怪出现，以往都没有这阵仗。”
沈易摇头道：
“不清楚，先静观其变吧。”
雾影怪已经堵在门口。
一旦打开门它们就会立刻闯进来，无法像对付灯笼鬼那般对付它们。
片刻后。
沈易透过缝隙观察外面的雾影怪，发现镇阴木屋对它们还是存在着一定的影响的。
雾影怪周身的黑雾正不断被镇阴木屋灵纹上闪烁的光芒消磨，化作丝丝青烟消散。
“有效果，只可惜效果不大。”
沈易目光随后落在后方院落中的那一堆被雾影怪干掉的灯笼鬼上。
粗略估算，应该有十几只之多。
“倒是意外之喜。”
除了他们院落里的灯笼鬼。
外面村子里应该也有一大堆灯笼鬼被雾影怪给干掉了。

明日早点出门，收获应该不小。
嘭嘭嘭——
撞门声还在不断响起。
【耐久值：96.8%，95.8%……90.8%……】
时间过去，房子的耐久值也在飞快下降。
直到夜里某一刻。
“啊！！！！”
一声凄惨的尖叫撕裂夜空。
沈易心中一颤，
有人出事了！
也是。
连他升级过的房子都被雾影怪给轻易侵蚀，其他人就更不用说了。
“那边应该是杨铭家的方向。”
他们心情凝重。
正是沈易昨天打水的时候经过的杨家婶子一家。
显然，他们家已经被雾影怪入侵，凶多吉少了。
夜色过半。
村子里一片黑沉死寂。
从远处时不时就会响起几声凄惨尖叫。
才几个时辰过去，村里已经有不少人遭了雾影怪的毒手。

沈易三兄妹死死守在屋内，时刻注意着外面的动静。
时间一分一秒过去。
在沈易的视野中，镇阴木屋的耐久值已经降到了二十点以下！

"I can't sleep tonight!"
There was only one thought left in Shen Yi's mind.
He didn't choose to upgrade his home immediately.
You need to keep an eye on it tonight. If more fog shadow monsters join in, it will cause greater damage to the durability of the house.
The existing durability value can last for a while, so try to gain more opportunities for turnover.
Shen Kun looked nervous and whispered: "Brother, how come there are so many fog shadow monsters appearing? There has never been such a battle before."
Shen Yi shook his head and said:
"I don't know. Let's wait and see what happens."
The fog shadow monster has blocked the door.
Once the door is opened, they will rush in immediately, and you cannot deal with them like you can with the Lantern Ghost.
After a while.
Shen Yi observed the fog shadow monsters outside through the gap and found that the Zhenyin wooden house still had a certain influence on them.
The black mist around the fog shadow monster is constantly being consumed by the flickering light on the spiritual pattern of the Zhenyin wooden house, turning into wisps of blue smoke and dissipating.
"It's effective, but it's just not very effective."
Shen Yi's eyes then fell on the pile of lantern ghosts killed by the fog shadow monster in the courtyard behind.
A rough estimate is that there should be as many as a dozen.
"It's an unexpected surprise."
Except for the lantern ghost in their courtyard.
There should also be a lot of lantern ghosts killed by the fog shadow monster in the village outside.
If you go out early tomorrow, you should gain a lot.
Bang bang bang——
The banging on the door continued.
[Durability value: 96.8%, 95.8%...90.8%...]
As time passes, the durability of the house decreases rapidly.
Until a certain point in the night.
"Ah!!!!"
A pitiful scream tore through the night sky.
Shen Yi's heart trembled,
Something happened!
Too.
Even his upgraded house was easily eroded by the fog shadow monster, let alone others.
"That side should be the direction of Yang Ming's house."
They were in a solemn mood.
It was the family of Aunt Yang who Shen Yi passed by while fetching water yesterday.
Obviously, their home has been invaded by the fog shadow monster, and the situation is in danger.
It's past midnight.
The village was completely dark and silent.
From time to time, several pitiful screams would be heard from a distance.
Only a few hours have passed, and many people in the village have already been poisoned by the fog shadow monster.
The three brothers and sisters Shen Yi stayed inside the house, always paying attention to what was going on outside.
Time passed by minute by minute.
In Shen Yi's field of vision, the durability value of the Zhenyin wooden house has dropped to less than 20 points!
